major_concerns: Deterministic validator coverage may miss runtime semantic failures (false negatives).
Synthesized tasks risk biasing toward repairable errors, inflating effect size.
Repair heuristics underspecified; could leak human tuning post-hoc.
Simulator fidelity for semantic correctness not fully justified.
required_design_repairs: Select and document a concrete validator (e.g., Batfish/Veriflow) and its coverage limits.
Specify repair algorithms precisely and freeze them in preregistration.
Strengthen dataset realism (multi-vendor syntax, diverse failure types) and justify synthesis rules.
Include semantic runtime replay tests with documented fidelity and failure-mode mapping.
Predefine seeds, retry policy, and hash-all artifacts for reproducibility.

major_concerns: Results highly sensitive to instrumented tool API design—limits generalizability.
Human annotation bottleneck may undermine statistical claims if underspecified.
Automated heuristics for failure labelling risk systematic misclassification.
required_design_repairs: Define canonical, minimal deterministic tool interfaces and publish schemas.
Pre-register annotation protocol, sample sizes, and inter-annotator agreement targets.
Reserve sufficient human-annotation budget or calibrate heuristics against a held-out validated sample.
Include multiple agent orchestration variants and seed control to test sensitivity.

major_concerns: Simulation/canary signal fidelity may not reflect production observability.
Canary subset selection and thresholding are operator-specific and can drive results.
Latency-safety tradeoffs depend on time-window choices—risk of cherry-picking.
required_design_repairs: Provide justification and validation of the simulation/emulation fidelity (compare to public traces or prior studies).
Pre-register canary selection heuristics and multiple threshold sweep for sensitivity analysis.
Define false-rollback cost model and include it in the analysis.
Report deployment-latency distribution and not only mean/aggregate metrics.

major_concerns: Legal/provenance and potential leakage risks from vendor example adaptation.
Synthetic realism may not capture production constraint interactions.
Dataset scope (1,000 tasks) may be insufficient to support broad generalization claims.
required_design_repairs: Provide a clear provenance, licensing, and sanitization pipeline; document transformations applied to source configs.
Increase task diversity or stratify dataset by difficulty/vendor and justify chosen sizes.
Include baseline runs and validation by domain experts to demonstrate dataset utility.
Publish dataset schema, evaluation scripts, and hashes to ensure reproducibility.
